clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, you face the Council of the Forest's demand for atonement. Adventurers were duped into doing Zenn Foulhoof's dirty work, and now the council sends you to trick the satyr into eating corrupted fel cones.

Just outside Dolanaar, solitary satyr Zenn Foulhoof uses deceit to make passersby do his bidding. Adventurers who unwittingly slaughtered nightsabers, strigid owls, and webwood spiders to satisfy his twisted appetites draw the Council of the Forest's sharp disapproval. The council will not accept harm to nature, especially from its own allies.

Syral Bladeleaf, Sentinel Kyra Starsong, or Sentinel Shayla Nightbreeze warns you that you must make amends to remain welcome in Teldrassil. Dolanaar's guardians tell you to turn Foulhoof's wicked gluttony against him instead of facing him with steel. Gather the billowing, corrupted fel cones from the forest floor, then offer the unsuspecting satyr a taste of his own foul medicine.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a traveler, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.
You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil.
Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke.
Give some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have for me, friend? A lovely snack I presume?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, what a sweet traveler! I knew you would come in handy!
